recipes.name: Vegan Red Pesto
ingredients: ½ cup oil from jar of sun-dried tomatoes
instructions: Heat a small pan over medium-high heat, and toast the almonds for 4 to 5 minutes, stirring throughout.
Add the toasted almonds and all the remaining ingredients to a food processor, and blend. Enjoy with crackers or as a spread on your favourite sandwich!

page_recipe_notes: Storage The pesto can be stored in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 5 days.
